posts.name: MindWanderer
posts.cooked:
Ooh, the wiki now has a longer bio of this variant:

Those hunting Michael have drawn ever closer. It's only a matter of time before they catch him. Cornered as he is, the Naturalist has been losing his grasp on humanity, struggling to maintain focus and keep a single, stable form. The Argent Adept found Michael Conteh once again in an inhuman state, but this time, the Naturalist was not a specific animal. Instead, he had the characteristics of several different animals, including animals he had never taken form of before. The musical magician helped his old ally calm and focus his mind, but his form continued shifting. Now, the Naturalist fights those who hunt him, though his powers are in continual flux.

His nemesis, Deadline, doesn't seem to be "hunting" him, per se.  The Naturalist is going after Deadline to protect Earth.  The same seems to apply to the Naturalist's mini-nemeses.  The only one mentioned as actively hunting the Naturalist is Ambuscade, but that's in his Vengeance incarnation.  So, not sure what to make of this.

posts.name: Braithwhite
posts.cooked:
The current speculation on the Steam thread is that the requirements are something like:

1. The naturalist needs to get the finishing blow on multiple villain character cards.  (which, in the case of the unlock show, was allowed by Rogue Agent KNYFE playing the bottom card of the Naturalist's deck, which finished off the baron)

2. The Naturalist may need to be in a different form each time the finishing blow is struck (so you need to get X villian character kills as the rhino, X as the gazelle, X as the crocodile)

3. Cornered Beast may need to be in play. 

4. My personal theory (that I am testing now) is that the Naturalist needs to get 1 villain kill in each form, with cornered beast in play. 

4(a). I'm kind of curious is members of the V5 would count towards this goal. Seems like they should.
